scientific_integrity: Proof uses a structural distance-four shell bound, a complete two-case counting argument, point-line duality and a legal five-source construction, corroborated by independently coded Python and C++ exhaustive enumerations of 810000 ordered four-tuples.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for the labelled thirty-vertex Tutte-Coxeter graph. Four-step schedules reaching 29 vertices are partial and not graph-burning sequences covering all vertices. The 2014 and 2015 general burning definitions, radius bound, and the doily graph construction are previously known. Historical priority against inaccessible or unindexed materials is not guaranteed. Two ordinary standalone programs were replayed; no external independent audit was carried out.
title: The one-vertex four-round burning deficit of Tutte's eight-cage
